captions.detailed: A compact, square-shaped desk fan in a light grey housing supported by a black tubular tabletop stand. The assembly features a continuous spinning three-blade fan at its center, a dark grey rear motor casing with a folding rear handle, and a small rotary control knob on the left side. The main fan housing tilts on horizontal stand pivots, the rear handle folds on short pivots, and the control knob rotates continuously on its axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a compact square desk fan with a tabletop stand, folding rear handle, and a left-side control knob. The main housing should tilt on its horizontal stand pivots, the rear handle should fold on short rear pivots, the central blade should spin continuously, and the left-side knob should rotate continuously on its axis.
captions.factory: Construct the main housing by extruding a rounded square and cutting a large central cylinder, adding a cross-shaped internal support grid. Create the stand using a swept profile along a bent tubular path, connected to the housing with hexagonal pivot pins. Model the fan blade by patterning three angled blades around a central cylinder hub. Add a cylindrical rear motor casing with a sweeping U-shaped handle, and construct a small cylindrical control knob on the left face of the housing.
